Creation of three time-limited non-civil service positions of one Director-General/Office for Attracting Strategic Enterprises (equivalent to the rank of D6), one Deputy Director-General/Office for Attracting Strategic Enterprises (equivalent to the rank of D3) and one Executive Director/Office for Attracting Strategic Enterprises (equivalent to the rank of D2) in the Office for Attracting Strategic Enterprises to carry on with and strengthen the efforts in attracting strategic enterprises to Hong Kong

Retention of one time-limited supernumerary post of Chief Systems Manager (D1) in the Department of Health with effect from 1 April 2024 or with immediate effect upon approval of the Finance Committee, whichever is the later, up to 31 March 2029 to continue providing senior level technical advice for IT development of Department of Health, steering and formulating IT strategies and innovation initiatives, and overseeing implementation of all IT projects of Department of Health

Creation of two time-limited supernumerary posts of one Administrative Officer Staff Grade C (D2) and one Chief Architect (D1) in the Housing Bureau to lead the operation of the Dedicated Team on Light Public Housing, providing policy steer on the implementation, construction, operation, allocation and publicity work, etc. of the Light Public Housing projects

Creation of one permanent post of Deputy Principal Government Counsel (DL2) and one time-limited supernumerary post of Assistant Principal Government Counsel (DL1)/DL1-equivalent non-civil service position for a period of five years in the Department of Justice with immediate effect upon approval of the Finance Committee to assist in the work relating to the International Organization for Mediation Preparatory Office and the establishment and future operation of the International Organization for Mediation and to implement the policy initiative of setting up a dedicated office and an expert group within 2024 to take forward the establishment of the Hong Kong International Legal Talents Training Academy

Making permanent of one time-limited supernumerary bi-disciplinary post of Chief Building Surveyor/Chief Structural Engineer (D1) in the Buildings Department with effect from 15 July 2024, or with effect upon approval of the Finance Committee, whichever is the later, to lead and oversee enforcement action against and policy reviews on unauthorised building works in New Territories Exempted Houses (NTEHs); and support building control and enforcement work against non-NTEHs in the New Territories to cope with growing workload arising from completed private buildings in the Northern Metropolis amongst others
